entities.title: Ship one self-contained, ReadyToRun executable
entities.summary: The project publishes as a single self-contained file with ReadyToRun code and its native libraries inside, untrimmed.
entities.context: zazzle-csharp-indexer is installed as one file, by the zazzle Homebrew formula or from a release tarball; an MCP client starts it for every session.
entities.decision: zazzle-csharp-indexer.csproj sets SelfContained, PublishSingleFile, PublishReadyToRun and IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract; Directory.Build.props targets net8.0 with invariant globalization. The release publishes one file per runtime identifier.
entities.rationale: Self-contained means no .NET runtime is needed on the machine, and a single file is all there is to install. The README lists the resulting size as a known limit.

entities.title: ToolVersion.Text comes from the release tag
entities.summary: Release builds pass the tag's version to dotnet publish and ToolVersion.Text reads it back from the assembly; every other build says 0.0.0-dev.
entities.context: ToolVersion.Text is what --version prints after the tool name, what MCP initialize reports as serverInfo.version and the only thing the daemon handshake compares, for serve and for zazzled, which learns the version from --version. It used to be a hand-written constant that release.yml neither set nor checked, so a release that changed behaviour without changing it left a daemon from the previous binary serving new clients until it idled out.

options.title: Bump ToolVersion.Text by hand in every release
options.consequences: No build change; relies on remembering, and nothing checks it matches the tag.

options.title: Derive it from the tag at build time and check it in the release workflow
options.consequences: Version and tag cannot drift; needs a build property and a workflow step.

options.title: Compare a build identity (for example a hash of the executable) in the handshake instead
options.consequences: Any new binary replaces an idle daemon, even without a version change.

entities.decision: Directory.Build.props sets Version to 0.0.0-dev and keeps the source revision out of the informational version. Both indexer builds in release.yml (macOS and Linux) run dotnet publish with -p:Version set to the version the version job derives from the tag with macos/release/version.sh. ToolVersion.Text is the assembly's informational version up to any +, or 0.0.0-dev when it has none. No step compares the built version with the tag afterwards; the tag is passed in, so they cannot drift.
entities.rationale: The git tag is the only source of version numbers for every binary in the release, so each release's indexer reports a version of its own and an idle daemon from the previous release is replaced (src/Daemon/.dev/decisions.json, version-restart).
entities.consequences: Every build made outside the release workflow reports 0.0.0-dev, so the handshake cannot tell two such builds apart (limitations.json, dev-builds-share-version).

origin.description: Raised while documenting the folder, when ToolVersion.Text was a constant release.yml did not refer to; taken by the owner in commit 5ea503c, which made the release tag the only version source.

entities.title: Whether to trim the published binary
entities.summary: The README lists the binary's size (Roslyn, ReadyToRun, untrimmed) as a known limit, and the C# rules keep the code trim-safe, but the project does not trim.
entities.context: macos/dotnet/style.md asks for JsonNode instead of reflection-based JSON "so trimming stays safe"; zazzle-csharp-indexer.csproj does not set PublishTrimmed; the README's Known limits name the untrimmed single file as large. Roslyn and Microsoft.Data.Sqlite would have to survive trimming.

options.title: Keep it untrimmed
options.consequences: Size stays as it is; the trim-safe rule only keeps the option open.

options.title: Trim it
options.consequences: A smaller download; needs the dependencies checked under trimming, and possibly trimming warnings handled, since warnings are errors.

origin.description: Raised while documenting the folder, from the README's Known limits and macos/dotnet/style.md.
